facts.fact: 清晨是 Zane 一天中最珍视的一小时：每天天亮他都骑马穿过空荡的公园
facts.anchor: Each day at dawn I rode through the empty park to feel the wind on my face without the fear of scaring small children.

facts.fact: 他的坐骑名叫 Minos，回家路上他一边让它慢下来一边拍着它出汗的鬃毛
facts.anchor: Slowing my stallion, Minos, to a walk, I patted his sweaty coat as both of us attempted to catch our breath.

facts.fact: Zane 自述白手起家，少年在街头赚每一丁点钞票，因此把仆人当朋友待
facts.anchor: But I’d been born with nothing, a boy who hustled on the street for every scrap of money he could find.

facts.fact: 这个清晨厨房在备一只茶点，与平日的节奏不同
facts.anchor: As I polished it on my coat, I noted a tea tray being prepared.

facts.fact: 管家 Fletcher 说来客是男主的妹妹 Camilla 约来的
facts.anchor: She said your sister asked her to meet here this morning.

facts.fact: 管家递上的厚卡片写着 Mrs. Orson Grey——来客就是 Caroline
Zane 决意把 Caroline 当成向 Orson Grey 报复的工具
facts.anchor: And his wife would be the instrument of my revenge.

facts.fact: 依当时的法律妻子不拥有财产与收入，Caroline 的一切都并入丈夫名下
facts.anchor: I owned no property, had no money of my own.
